description: Java class 'PackedRecordPointer' that manages packing and unpacking of record pointers and partition IDs for Spark shuffle sorting.

classes.name: PackedRecordPointer
classes.description: A final class that provides static methods and instance methods to pack and unpack record pointers and partition IDs into a 64-bit long value.

methods.name: packPointer
methods.description: Static method that encodes a record pointer and partition ID into a single long value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Instance method to set the packed record pointer value.

methods.name: getPartitionId
methods.description: Instance method to extract the partition ID from the packed pointer.

methods.name: getRecordPointer
methods.description: Instance method to decode and retrieve the record pointer from the packed value.
